rewards:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a SINGLE production Minecraft pixel-art sprite atlas for the HBK parallel-world alloys.
Create a square transparent-background atlas in exactly 6 columns and 6 rows, 36 equal square cells, no borders, no text. Read left to right then top to bottom. Each icon strictly centered in its cell with 3 logical pixels padding. Each cell looks like original hand-pixelled 16x16 Minecraft inventory art enlarged with nearest neighbor: hard square pixels, 7-12 carefully clustered colors, highlights upper left, restrained mineral/steel/copper/leather palette; no smooth gradients, photographic textures, drop shadows, antialiasing, white outline, tiny unreadable noise. Every tool is a new designed silhouette, never a recolor of vanilla gear. Each silhouette must explain the function. Provide these 35 sprites in order, last cell empty:
Row1: copper plated gliding chestplate with two folded ivory membrane wings; blue steel drill pickaxe with screw auger head and short wooden grip; pale green mining helmet with square amber headlamp; root steel forest axe with serrated hooked edge; bronze field hoe with wide double tines; bronze field shovel with broad square scoop.
Row2: turquoise entry compass with square furnace sigil dial; teal articulated construction gauntlet; leather repair roll with two protruding wrench handles; slate heavy anchor boots with bolted soles; brass expedition barometer with sun/rain split dial; steel three-prong grappling hook with coiled rope.
Row3: green twin-cylinder breathing tank with brass valve; pale steel impulse crossbow with copper coils and cyan bolt channel; lilac sail boots with small folded side fins; blue long handled seismic hammer with heavy rectangular head and brass resonator; spring steel shield with a visible central compression coil; blue diving boots with weighted toes and cuff valves.
Row4: riveted row-building dispenser tool with front nozzle and brick magazine; heavy blue blast shield with chevron reinforcement; violet gravity chestplate with circular counterweight in chest; small reinforced cargo minecart with two latch crates; violet two-prong tuning fork with metal handle; copper smelting pickaxe with vented furnace head and amber core.
Row5: green hermetic helmet with glass visor and twin side filters; steel rope-ladder spool showing wooden rungs and rope; olive curved harvest sickle; turquoise pair of hinged carrying clamps; olive sample satchel with three mineral vials; blue leather miner belt with steel horseshoe magnet.
Row6: copper heat cartridge with ribbed glowing amber core; green ore compass with crystal needle; purple rift sword with split angular blade; slate compact shaped-charge canister with orange fuse; light blue return capsule with square glass center and folded handle; EMPTY.
Transparent background must remain truly transparent. No captions, frame or checkerboard.
devices:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE Minecraft block texture sheet, exact 6 columns by 6 rows, square equal cells, orthographic FLAT face textures, not item sprites or rendered cubes.
Primary request: original vanilla-style 16x16 pixel-art machine textures enlarged with nearest neighbor. Each cell filled edge-to-edge, exact grid, no labels, gaps or frames between cells. Discrete chunky square pixels, 7-12 colors per tile, no antialiasing, gradients, photographs, outlines or perspective. Restrained steel, copper, brass and desaturated crystal accents, wear in small pixel clusters.
Each machine uses THREE consecutive tiles: FRONT, SIDE, TOP. Two machines per row.
Row1: recycling anvil (gray riveted metal with amber intake slot, braced dark side, worn steel work surface); wind vane (steel arrow in square gauge face, metal socket side, copper compass-rose top).
Row2: lift platform (steel edge with chevron stripe, riveted piston side, segmented blue metal lift deck); greenhouse lamp (luminous warm square lattice front, brass cage side, pale luminous square lattice top).
Row3: air purifier (green filter with three dark vents and tiny amber gauge, gray cartridge panel side, circular gridded fan top); anomaly sensor (purple crystal eye in steel frame front, coil panel side, square violet gauge top).
Row4: phase glass (cyan metal frame with truly transparent central pane, cyan thin lattice with transparent center, cyan square crystal rim with transparent center); washing trough (copper basin outlet face, green patina braced side, open blue water basin with copper rim top).
Row5: drain pump (teal valve and short pipe face, steel ribbed pump side, circular brass pressure gauge top); transition plate (blue glowing slot in metal edge front, riveted silver side, concentric cyan angular teleporting pattern top).
Row6: rhythm controller (eight tiny redstone indicator squares in two lines front, copper wire tracks side, stepped redstone sequencer top); then THREE EMPTY transparent cells.
Textures must read as hand-authored vanilla-resolution pixel textures. No text, no extraneous objects. Only the phase glass centers and final blank cells are transparent, all other tiles opaque.
